## How it works

- [statement] Opaque or shifting conversion rules trigger backlash. EigenLayer's May 2024 airdrop drew criticism for non-transferable tokens, exclusion of users in more than a dozen countries who could still deposit, and unclear treatment of points earned through liquid restaking. Tensor and EigenLayer both revised terms after criticism, and Blur was criticised for extending its points window and changing airdrop rules. Compound's founder called points the largest information asymmetry in crypto. (medium confidence) — https://malaysia.news.yahoo.com/eigenlayers-eigen-airdrop-might-signal-231248249.html · keywords: Airdrop and points program design and eligibility · also: https://galaxy.com/insights/research/crypto-points-programs
- [statement] Rewarding raw activity counts attracts farmers. In Optimism's Airdrop 5 the 'Frequent User' bonus (10 or more app transactions a week in at least 20 weeks) cut 30-day retention by 7.1 percentage points, while 'Superchain Explorer' (activity on 7 or more chains) raised it 4.7 points and 'SuperFest Participant' raised it 10.0 points; the authors suspect farmers sell and leave. An academic study of nine airdrops makes the same point: when transaction count is the metric, low fees let farmers hit thresholds cheaply. (medium confidence) — https://gov.optimism.io/t/did-op-airdrop-5-increase-user-retention-rates-a-regression-discontinuity-analysis/9610 · keywords: Airdrop and points program design and eligibility · also: https://arxiv.org/html/2312.02752v4

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Jito's validator and searcher allocations were 50% claimable at genesis and 50% vesting linearly over 12 months. Claims were valid for 18 months, with unclaimed tokens returning to the DAO treasury. (low confidence) — https://www.chaincatcher.com/en/article/2107694 · keywords: Airdrop and points program design and eligibility

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Scoping the 'airdrops fail' headline: after Arbitrum's airdrop, unique addresses stayed about 50% above pre-airdrop levels and TVL rose over 50% without a significant drop, but per-address transaction counts fell to under 75% of pre-airdrop. The authors call airdrops possibly necessary to attract users initially but insufficient to build a committed community. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/html/2312.02752v4 · keywords: Airdrop and points program design and eligibility

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Projects use points before a token exists to steer user behaviour. Rewarded actions seen on Solana include trading volume and PnL, lending and borrowing, liquidity provision, referrals, asset boosts, and not listing NFTs on rival marketplaces. Points need no fixed emissions schedule, so the team can retune rates between seasons. (medium confidence) — https://threesigma.xyz/blog/point-programs · keywords: Airdrop and points program design and eligibility · also: https://galaxy.com/insights/research/crypto-points-programs
- [statement] Solana points programs write anti-gaming rules into the criteria: Tensor Season 1 required at least 500 SOL of NFT trading volume and banned wash trading; Tensor Season 2 rewarded loyalty (not listing on other marketplaces); Parcl can revoke points from self-referrals; Kamino limits LST-only or stablecoin-only farming. Points can also distort behaviour: Zeta users felt pushed into market orders and took slippage. (medium confidence) — https://threesigma.xyz/blog/point-programs · keywords: Airdrop and points program design and eligibility · also: https://galaxy.com/insights/research/crypto-points-programs
- [statement] Jito excluded all past and current core contributors, including core-contributor wallets holding JitoSOL, validators they operate and canary searchers they operate. Recipients had 18 months from the token generation date to claim; after that, unclaimed JTO moves permissionlessly to the DAO treasury's Realms wallet. (medium confidence) — https://www.jito.network/blog/jto-airdrop-eligibility-and-allocation-specifications · keywords: Airdrop and points program design and eligibility · also: https://www.chaincatcher.com/en/article/2107694
